profile.name: 静态DDS输出组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验控制程序中定义和管理静态DDS样输出通道。它用于设置频率、幅度、相位以及可选的门控开关，并在实验时序中生成、检查和展开相关指令，而不是直接对应某一特定厂商的实体仪器。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used to define and manage static DDS-like output channels in an experiment control program. It is used to set frequency, amplitude, phase, and optional gate control, and to generate, validate, and expand timing instructions for experiments rather than representing a specific physical instrument from a particular manufacturer.

registry.name: Static DDS (Direct Digital Synthesizer)
registry.description: Static DDS (Direct Digital Synthesizer)是一款表征设备，主要功能包括使能、关闭、打开、禁用、触发。支持Signal, Slot, add device等操作。
